name: What happens during the countertop templating appointment?

mainEntity.name: What happens during the countertop templating appointment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Countertop templating is the process of creating an exact physical or digital template of your cabinet layout to guide slab cutting. It occurs after your base cabinets are fully secured and leveled, but before stone fabrication begins. During templating, technicians measure wall angles, seam placements, overhangs, and cutouts for sinks and cooktops. Because walls are rarely perfectly straight, templating ensures the finished stone fits tight against your drywall and minimizes unsightly gaps before any tile backsplash work begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installers take precise digital or physical measurements of your leveled cabinets, walls, and fixture cutouts so fabricators can cut your slabs to fit your exact kitchen dimensions.
